27514-a-handful-of-stars-texts-that-have.title: Texts That Have Moved Great Minds
27514-a-handful-of-stars-texts-that-have.creator: Unknown
27514-a-handful-of-stars-texts-that-have.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. A great romance is a portrait of humanity, painted by a master-hand. When the novelist employs the majestic words of revelation to transfigure the lives of his characters, he does so because, in actual experience, he finds those selfsame words indelibly engraven upon the souls of men.

29624-sir-walter-scott.title: Scott
29624-sir-walter-scott.creator: George
29624-sir-walter-scott.description: A book by George. He was connected, though remotely, with gentle families on both sides. That is to say, his great-grandfather was son of the Laird of Raeburn, who was grandson of Walter Scott of Harden and the 'Flower of Yarrow.

arxiv-2104-03714.title: The defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation with step-like oscillatory initial data
arxiv-2104-03714.creator: Samuel Fromm 1, Jonatan Lenells 1, Ronald Quirchmayr 2
arxiv-2104-03714.description: Abstract . We study the Cauchy problem for the defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation under the assumption that the solution vanishes as x → + ∞ x\to+\infty and approaches an oscillatory plane wave as x → − ∞ x\to-\infty . We first develop an inverse scattering transform formalism for solutions satisfying such step-like boundary conditions.

arxiv-2109-14593.title: Federated Learning over Next-Generation Ethernet Passive Optical Networks
arxiv-2109-14593.creator: Oscar J. Ciceri, Carlos A. Astudillo, Zuqing Zhu, and Nelson L. S. da Fonseca, Oscar J. Ciceri, Carlos A. Astudillo, Zuqing Zhu, and Nelson L. S. da Fonseca
arxiv-2109-14593.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning (ML) type of processing that preserves the privacy of user data, sharing only the parameters of ML models with a common server. The processing of FL requires specific latency and bandwidth demands that need to be fulfilled by the operation of the communication network.

arxiv-2211-11550.title: Refactoring = Substitution + Rewriting
arxiv-2211-11550.creator: Simon Thompson, Dániel Horpácsi
arxiv-2211-11550.description: Abstract Eelco Visser’s work has always encouraged stepping back from the particular to look at the underlying, conceptual problems. In that spirit we present an approach to describing refactorings that abstracts away from particular refactorings to classes of similar transformations, and presents an implementation of these that works by substitution and subsequent rewriting.

arxiv-2302-03897.title: Improved precision of radial velocity measurements after correction for telluric absorption
arxiv-2302-03897.creator: A. Ivanova, R. Lallement, J.-L. Bertaux
arxiv-2302-03897.description: Abstract Context. The detection of planets around other stars by the measurement of the stellar Radial Velocity (RV) variations benefits from improvements of dedicated spectrographs, allowing to achieve a precision of 1 ms -1 or better. Spectral intervals within which stellar lines are contaminated by telluric lines are classically excluded from the RV processing. Aims.

arxiv-2401-13333.title: Metastable strings and grand unification
arxiv-2401-13333.description: Abstract The structure of the Standard Model (SM) of particle physics points toward grand unified theories (GUTs) where strong and electroweak interactions are unified in a non-Abelian GUT group. The spontaneous breaking of the GUT symmetry to the SM symmetry, together with cosmic inflation, generically leads to metastable topological defects, the most prominent example being cosmic strings.

arxiv-2407-13146.title: PG-Rainbow: Using Distributional Reinforcement Learning in Policy Gradient Methods
arxiv-2407-13146.creator: WooJae Jeon, KangJun Lee, Jeewoo Lee
arxiv-2407-13146.description: Abstract This paper introduces PG-Rainbow, a novel algorithm that incorporates a distributional reinforcement learning framework with a policy gradient algorithm. Existing policy gradient methods are sample inefficient and rely on the mean of returns when calculating the state-action value function, neglecting the distributional nature of returns in reinforcement learning tasks.

arxiv-2506-02618.title: Rodrigues Network for Learning Robot Actions
arxiv-2506-02618.creator: Jialiang ZhangPeking University, Haoran GengUC Berkeley, Yang YouStanford UniversityCongyue DengStanford UniversityPieter AbbeelUC BerkeleyJitendra MalikUC BerkeleyLeonidas GuibasStanford University
arxiv-2506-02618.description: Abstract Understanding and predicting articulated actions is important in robot learning. However, common architectures such as MLPs and Transformers lack inductive biases that reflect the underlying kinematic structure of articulated systems. To this end, we propose the Neural Rodrigues Operator , a learnable generalization of the classical forward kinematics operation, designed to inject kinematics-aware inductive bias into neural computation.

arxiv-2509-15284.title: A moderate share of V2G outperforms large-scale smart charging of electric vehicles and benefits other consumers
arxiv-2509-15284.creator: Adeline Guéret, Carlos Gaete-Morales, Wolf-Peter Schill
arxiv-2509-15284.description: Abstract While battery electric vehicles (BEVs) play a key role for decarbonizing the transport sector, their impact on the power sector heavily depends on their charging strategies. Here we systematically analyze various combinations between inflexible, smart and bidirectional (or vehicle-to-grid, V2G) charging of 15 million electric cars in Germany.

arxiv-2510-07573.title: Good things always come in 3s: trimodality in the binary black-hole chirp-mass distribution supports bimodal black-hole formation
arxiv-2510-07573.creator: R. Willcox, F. R. N. Schneider, E. Laplace, P. Podsiadlowski, K. Maltsev, I. Mandel, P. Marchant, H. Sana, T. G. F. Li, T. Hertog
arxiv-2510-07573.description: Abstract The latest GWTC-4 release from the LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA (LVK) collaboration nearly doubles the known population of double compact object mergers and reveals a new trimodal structure in the chirp-mass distribution of merging binary black holes (BBHs) below 30 M ⊙ M_{\odot} .

arxiv-2510-26451.title: Robust Graph Condensation via Classification Complexity Mitigation
arxiv-2510-26451.creator: Jiayi Luo, Qingyun Sun, Beining Yang, Haonan Yuan, Xingcheng Fu, Yanbiao Ma, Jianxin Li, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2510-26451.description: Abstract Graph condensation (GC) has gained significant attention for its ability to synthesize smaller yet informative graphs. However, existing studies often overlook the robustness of GC in scenarios where the original graph is corrupted. In such cases, we observe that the performance of GC deteriorates significantly, while existing robust graph learning technologies offer only limited effectiveness.

arxiv-2601-20180.title: On the Computational Complexity of Performative Prediction
arxiv-2601-20180.creator: Ioannis Anagnostides, Rohan Chauhan, Ioannis Panageas, Tuomas Sandholm, Jingming Yan
arxiv-2601-20180.description: Abstract Performative prediction captures the phenomenon where deploying a predictive model shifts the underlying data distribution. While simple retraining dynamics are known to converge linearly when the performative effects are weak ( ρ < 1 \rho<1 ), the complexity in the regime ρ > 1 \rho>1 was hitherto open.

Background: We have previously reported that treatment with recombinant human growth hormone (rhGH) can influence testicular growth and puberty onset in children with GH deficiency (GHD), and suggested GH as a determinant of testicular growth in childhood (doi: 10.3389/fendo.2021.619895).

pmc-12436708.title: Efficacy of Collimated Light Therapy for Seasonal Affective Disorder: study protocol
pmc-12436708.creator: M Giordano, G Longo, L Orsolini, U Volpe
pmc-12436708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionLight therapy is a treatment that involves daily exposure to bright light. It is most commonly used to treat seasonal affective disorder (SAD). The standard light therapy regimen for SAD typically involves sitting in front of a light box that emits 10,000 lux of light at a distance of 20 cm from the eyes for 30 minutes per day, preferably in the morning. suggested that increasing the illuminance in light therapy, using a Bright, whole-ROom, All-Day (BROAD) approach, may enhance its effectiveness.

pmc-12641403.title: Self-directed digital interventions for the improvement of emotion regulation – acceptability and feasibility for adolescents: systematic review
pmc-12641403.creator: Abigail Thomson, Erin Lawrence, Enxhi Sharxhi, Bonamy Oliver, Ben Wright, Georgina Hosang
pmc-12641403.description: BackgroundIn-person, therapist-supported interventions targeting emotion regulation have been shown to improve the mental health of adolescents. Increasingly, self-directed digital interventions (e.g. mobile apps) are being developed as a cost-effective, scalable solution to widen access to support. However, evidence of the acceptability and feasibility of these interventions has yet to be synthesised.

pmc-13053748.title: Parabacteroides distasonis ameliorates ovariectomy-induced bone loss by regulating the gut microbiota and Th17/Treg balance
pmc-13053748.creator: Wenyuan Hou, Fangjun Xiao, Jiaru Liao, Junjiao Zhang, Longfei Han, MinCong He, Qiushi Wei
pmc-13053748.description: SummaryPostmenopausal osteoporosis is linked to estrogen deficiency, immune imbalance, and gut microbiota alterations that can promote bone loss. Using an ovariectomized (OVX) rat model, we found that Parabacteroides distasonis abundance decreased after OVX. Oral supplementation with live P. distasonis improved distal femoral trabecular microarchitecture and increased femoral bending strength, alongside shifts in bone turnover markers consistent with reduced resorption.

Here we identified gene ilvA encoding threonine deaminase as a flux-sensitive node linking branched-chain amino-acid synthesis to nitrogen sensing. Complete ilvA deletion or σ54 disruption in H.

pmc-13183737.title: Effectiveness of survivorship programmes to enhance health-related quality of life of colorectal cancer survivors: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
pmc-13183737.creator: Pham Nhat Vi Do, Thi Khanh Nguyen, Yishu Qi, Kai Chow Choi, Thi Xuan Huong Hoang, Ba Phuoc Le, Yuen Tung Lam, Mankei Tse, Cho Lee Wong
pmc-13183737.description: PurposeThis study aimed to assess the effectiveness of the survivorship programmes by synthesising and analysing the available evidence to enhance health-related quality of life (HRQoL) amongst colorectal cancer (CRC) survivors.MethodsTen English-language databases were searched from inception to June 2025 in this systematic review and meta-analysis. All randomised controlled trials (RCTs) were included.

pmc-13202999.title: Deaf people’s experience of the digital transformation of UK healthcare services: a qualitative study using semi-structured interviews
pmc-13202999.creator: Emmanuel Chan, Sarah Wigham, Amy O’Donnell
pmc-13202999.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHealthcare services are being transformed with the rapid adoption of digital technology, particularly since the COVID-19 pandemic. However, concerns have been expressed around digital exclusion of potentially vulnerable groups such as those experiencing mental health conditions and/or sensory impairment. This study sought to explore deaf people’s experiences of the digital transformation of UK healthcare services and identify opportunities for future service improvement.MethodA qualitative study using a social constructionist approach was conducted with data collected using semi-structured interviews.

pmc-13411218.title: Biomechanical Comparison of Hybrid Technique and Traditional Dual-Growing Rods Alone in the Treatment of Severe Early Onset Scoliosis
pmc-13411218.creator: Chenkai Li, You Du, Hanming Bian, Yang Yang, Guanfeng Lin, Yiwei Zhao, Xiaohan Ye, Jianguo Zhang, Shengru Wang
pmc-13411218.description: Background: Currently, there is a lack of biomechanical studies on traditional dual-growing rods (TDGR) combined with apical osteotomy and short-segment fusion (hybrid technique, HT). This study compared the differences in clinical outcomes and biomechanics between TDGR and HT in the treatment of severe early-onset scoliosis (sEOS) via finite element analysis (FEA) and in vitro biomechanical experiments.

pmc-13556520.title: 404. Hyperactive catatonia in autism and schizoaffective disorder: diagnostic pitfalls and pharmacological insights
pmc-13556520.creator: A Mitrea, D Lambert, M Kosel
pmc-13556520.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCatatonia is a severe psychomotor syndrome frequently associated with psychotic and mood disorders, and may be under-recognized when overlapping with obsessive-compulsive or neurodevelopmental symptoms. Pharmacological response can provide crucial diagnostic and therapeutic guidance, particularly in treatment-resistant presentations.Aims & ObjectivesThe aim of this case report is to describe a severe episode of hyperactive catatonia occurring in a patient with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and schizophrenia conceptualized as schizoaffective disorder.
